symptom: On entering Renovaciones the user observes values change immediately from one set to another.
rootCause: renewals-v1200-operational-bridge wrapped the base render and deferred enhance(host) with setTimeout(...,0). The browser could paint the base renewal metrics/actions before the operational bridge replaced them with scoped operational metrics/actions.

fix.behavior: Run enhance(host) synchronously inside the same render call so the browser does not expose an intermediate renewal authority.

dataAuthority: No second datastore was demonstrated; the defect was two sequential UI composition passes over the same runtime store, with non-identical selection logic.
requiredProof: Fresh load on Renovaciones shows one stable metric/action state
No visible counter/button swap after first paint
